meta.title: AI voice agent for call centers demo
meta.description: Interactive demo with sample data: listen to four calls (banking, healthcare, collections and orders) with your browser’s voice, a synced and masked transcript, intent, sentiment, the agent’s simulated actions, a handoff to a human agent with context, an outbound campaign with contact-hour rules and calculated metrics.

llm.desc: Understands the intent, decides which action to run and writes the answer following your scripts and policies.

implementation.costNote: You pay each provider directly for telephony minutes, speech recognition, synthesized voice and the language model.

stt.def: Speech recognition: turns what the customer says into text.

tts.def: Speech synthesis: turns the agent’s answer into audio.

intent.def: What the customer wants to solve (for example, rescheduling an appointment).

sentiment.def: Whether the customer sounds satisfied, neutral or upset on each turn.

functions.def: Lookups or changes the agent makes in your systems during the call.

handoff.def: Passing the call to a person together with the summary, so the customer does not repeat anything.

containment.def: Share of answered calls the AI agent resolves without passing them to a human.

aht.def: Average handle time: how long an answered call lasts on average.

csat.def: Average of the 1-to-5 survey at the end of the call.

bargeIn.def: Lets the customer talk over the agent, which stops to listen.

footer.sampleNote: Sample data: the companies, people, numbers and IDs are fictitious. The calls follow a fixed script (no AI model runs in this demo), your browser generates the voice and the integrations (core banking, scheduling, collections, WhatsApp, payments, CRM) are simulated. Your test calls and personalization are stored only in this browser.
footer.cta: Request a demo with your script

banca.name: Banking: purchase declined while traveling
banca.desc: The customer calls because a purchase abroad was declined; the agent verifies their identity, registers the travel notice and enables the card.
banca.nextStep: Confirm the purchase in Lima went through and remind her she can register travel notices in the app.

spoken.doc: one zero two nine eight four four five six seven

turns.t1: Hi, I’m {agent}, the virtual assistant at {company}. Please note this call is recorded for quality and security, and we process your data under our privacy policy. How can I help you?
turns.t2: Hi. A purchase with my credit card was declined and I don’t understand why.
turns.t3: Sorry about that. To help you, could you confirm your ID number?
turns.t5: Thanks, Camila, I’ve verified your identity. I see a purchase of 386,000 pesos in Lima was declined last night: our security system blocked it because it was made outside Colombia.
turns.t6: Yes, I’m traveling in Lima until October 16. Can you enable it?
turns.t7: Done: I registered your travel notice for Peru until October 16 and enabled your card ending in 1234 for purchases there. You can try the purchase again now.
turns.t9: You’re welcome, Camila. I’ve logged this call in your history. Have a great trip!

results.getTransactions: Declined on 10/07/2026 at 21:42 · Lima (PE) · COP 386,000 · reason: purchase outside Colombia
results.unblockCard: Card ****1234 enabled for purchases in Peru until 10/16/2026
results.logCallCrm: Case CRM-20481 created: resolved by the AI agent

flow.greeting: Greeting with the bank’s name plus the recording and data-processing notice.
flow.identify: Asks for the ID number and validates it against the core system before sharing information.
flow.action: Looks up transactions, registers the trip and enables the card.
flow.end: Confirms, logs the call in the CRM and says goodbye.

assist.s1: Confirm with Camila that the purchase in Lima went through.
assist.s2: Remind her she can register travel notices from the app.
assist.s3: Don’t ask for her ID again: the AI agent already verified it.

a1.title: Enabling a card after a purchase abroad
a1.body: If the person is verified and confirms the trip, register the notice and enable the card for the given country and dates. There is no need to issue a new card.

a2.title: Travel notice: validity and countries
a2.body: A notice covers up to 90 days and several countries. It can be changed or cancelled in the app or by phone.

salud.name: Healthcare: confirm or reschedule an appointment
salud.desc: Outbound call to confirm a medical appointment; the patient asks to move it and the agent checks the schedule, reschedules it and sends the confirmation by WhatsApp.
salud.nextStep: If the patient needs another time, offer the available slots for the following week.

spoken.doc: seven nine four five zero eight nine one two

turns.t1: Good morning, this is {agent}, the virtual assistant at {company}. This call is recorded for quality and we process your data under our privacy policy. Am I speaking with Jorge Medina?
turns.t3: Thank you, Jorge. To protect your information, could you confirm your ID number?
turns.t5: Great. I’m calling to confirm your internal medicine appointment on Tuesday, October 13 at 7:20 in the morning at the Chapinero site. Can you make it?
turns.t6: Oh, I can’t that day. Could you move it to Thursday afternoon?
turns.t7: Sure. On Thursday, October 15 there are slots at 2:40 or 4:00 in the afternoon with the same doctor. Which one do you prefer?
turns.t9: Done: your appointment is now on Thursday, October 15 at 4:00 in the afternoon at the Chapinero site. I released Tuesday’s slot and sent you the confirmation by WhatsApp.
turns.t11: You’re welcome, Jorge. Remember to arrive 15 minutes early. Have a nice day!

results.getAppointment: Appointment CT-77310 · internal medicine · Tue 10/13/2026, 7:20 a.m. · Chapinero site
results.findAvailability: Slots on Thu 10/15/2026: 2:40 p.m. and 4:00 p.m.
results.rescheduleAppointment: Appointment CT-77310 moved to Thu 10/15/2026, 4:00 p.m.; Tuesday slot released

flow.greeting: Greeting, recording notice and confirmation that it is speaking with the patient.
flow.identify: Validates the ID against the clinic’s schedule.
flow.intent: Confirm the appointment; the patient asks to reschedule it.
flow.action: Finds slots, reschedules the appointment and sends the confirmation by WhatsApp.
flow.end: Reminds the patient to arrive 15 minutes early and logs the call in the CRM.

assist.s1: Confirm the new time works and that he knows the site’s address.
assist.s2: If he asks for another specialist, check his health insurer’s authorization.
assist.s3: Remind him to bring his previous test results.

a1.title: Appointment rescheduling policy
a1.body: Appointments can be rescheduled free of charge up to 2 hours before. The released slot goes back to the schedule immediately.

a2.title: Preparing for the internal medicine appointment
a2.body: Arrive 15 minutes early with an ID document and test results from the last 6 months.

cobranza.name: Preventive collections: payment agreement
cobranza.desc: Outbound call within the allowed hours to remind a customer of an installment; she proposes paying in two parts and the agent registers the agreement and sends the payment link by WhatsApp.
cobranza.nextStep: Follow up on the October 15 payment; if it does not arrive, call again within the allowed hours.

turns.t1: Hi, this is {agent}, the virtual assistant at {company}. This call is recorded and we process your data under our privacy policy. Am I speaking with Natalia Ortiz?
turns.t3: Thank you, Natalia. To validate your identity, could you confirm your ID number?
turns.t5: Thanks. I’m calling to remind you that your loan’s October installment, 412,500 pesos, is due on October 15. Will you be able to pay it on time?
turns.t6: Money is tight this month. I can pay half now and the rest at the end of the month.
turns.t7: I understand. I can offer you an agreement: 206,250 pesos by October 15 and 206,250 pesos by October 30, with no late interest if you meet both dates. Does that work for you?
turns.t9: Done: I registered the payment agreement and sent you a WhatsApp with the link to pay the first part.
turns.t11: Thank you, Natalia. Have a nice day.

flow.greeting: Calls within the allowed hours; greeting and recording notice.
flow.identify: Validates the ID against the collections system.
flow.intent: Reminds her of the installment; she asks for a payment agreement.
flow.action: Proposes a plan, registers the agreement and sends the payment link by WhatsApp.

assist.s1: Confirm both agreement dates and the amount of each payment.
assist.s2: Explain that the payment link arrived by WhatsApp and expires on October 15.
assist.s3: If she asks for more time, review the current refinancing options.

a1.title: Payment agreements: conditions
a1.body: An installment can be split into 2 payments within the same month, with no late interest if the dates are met.

a2.title: Contact hours for collections
a2.body: Only call Monday to Friday 7:00 to 19:00 and Saturdays 8:00 to 15:00; never on Sundays or public holidays. Respect the do-not-call list.

pedido.name: Order: status and damaged product
pedido.desc: The customer asks about an order and reports a damaged product; the agent opens a warranty case and transfers the call to a human agent with the summary.
pedido.nextStep: Handle the blender replacement: confirm the address and schedule the pickup.

a1.title: Warranty for products damaged in transit
a1.body: If a product arrives damaged, it is replaced free of charge. Ask for photos of the product and the packaging, and schedule the pickup within 48 business hours.

a2.title: Orders with several packages
a2.body: An order may arrive in several packages from different warehouses; each package has its own tracking.
